effect.menu-tip: Import purchased embroidery files into this document (PES, DST, JEF, VP3, and more)

param.name: design-files
param.gui-description: Select one or more embroidery files. Each file becomes a named group on the canvas.

param.name: import-commands
param.gui-description: How trim and stop commands from the file are brought into the document.

param.name: center-in-hoop
param.gui-description: Each design is centred on the page, staggered slightly so stacked imports are easier to grab.

page.name: info
page.label: Design Tray
Merge purchased designs into the open document without replacing it. Open would start a new file; Design Tray keeps your hoop, lettering, and other designs.

Supported stitch formats include PES, DST, JEF, VP3, EXP, XXX, SEW, HUS, PEC and the other formats Ink/Stitch can open, plus SVG. Colour-only files (.edr, .col, .inf) are skipped — use Thread Color Management → Apply Threadlist for those.
After importing: arrange in the Brother PE900 5×7 hoop, run Edit → Color Order to cut thread changes, then Visualize and Export → Prepare for PE900.
